column1: # CEC traces replayed by SourceOffTest (apps/core/lumen-hdmi/test/run.sh). Columns: trace, time (hh:mm:ss), event, arg.
#   init  L:P:T:S   CEC device L behind port P, device type T, cached power status S before the first line
#   shown P / hidden P   tvinput's session on HDMI P (HDMI_EVENT "session", X50: the port provider)
#   rx    HEX       a received CEC frame as dumpsys hdmi_control prints it (header:opcode:params)
#   expect  from to  SourceOff must answer "sleep" once at a read in [from, to] and never before or after
#   never            SourceOff must never answer "sleep" in this trace
# ps5-rest: a test Z9X G0082, Lumen 1.1.0-beta2, PS5 on HDMI 1 (1.0.0.0, logical 8), 2026-11-26, rest mode at
# 11:32:33, dumpsys hdmi_control (~/lumen-build-tmp/cec-standby-1126/live/hdmi_control.txt). The user switched HDMI
# 2 and 1 four times; at 11:31:15 the cache still held the PS5's standby report of 11:31:08 while it was waking up.
# ps5-off: the same unit, PS5 FULL power off at 11:49:54, 2026-11-26 (hdmi_control_2.txt there): no <Standby> either,
# its standby answer to our minute poll at 11:50:08.
# Opened while the console sleeps and never woken: the user looks at a sleeping source, nothing turned off.
# A source that only says it has no video (<Inactive Source>, CEC 1.4b 13.2.2) and stays on.
# Yandex Station (playback 4, HDMI 2 = 2.0.0.0) says <Standby>: the framework sleeps the projector itself
# (HdmiCecLocalDevice.handleStandby -> goToSleep HDMI); nothing more from us, also after its standby report.
# Yandex Station turning itself off with <Inactive Source> and a standby report: the same as the PS5.
# A soundbar (audio system 5) and the PS5 behind HDMI 1: the bar stays on, the console goes to rest.
# The source on ANOTHER port turns off while HDMI 1 is shown: not the watched device.
# Left HDMI 1 while the console was on, it went to rest meanwhile, then HDMI 1 opened again: a sleeping source.
# box-r-sleep: Slava's X50 Ultra, Lumen 1.0.10-beta14, Box R 4K Plus (Android 14, playback, logical 8) on HDMI 2
# (2.0.0.0), 2026-11-26 (~/lumen-build-tmp/x50-cec-live-1126, testB2). HDMI 2 opened at 14:07:23, the box answered
# with <Active Source>; put to sleep at 14:07:51 it sent nothing at all (its own HDMI layer: "Auto device off switch
# is disabled"), only its standby answer to our minute poll at 14:08:20. beta14 has no SourceFollow and stayed on.
# box-r-wake-home: the same box woken at 14:02:46 while the projector showed Lumen Home (testA): no One Touch Play
# from the box (its HDMI layer: "Projector cec fun is disable"), its power answer on; nothing is shown, so nothing.
